digest.component_or_area: CLI command flags (edit and claim commands)
propositions: edit --review must parse as a valueless flag without consuming the next token, commit the EDIT event first, then invoke review_plan(ticket_id, sign=True) and exit with ADR-0040 disposition codes (0 PASS / 1 BLOCK / 2 INDETERMINATE / 11 retryable)

claim --review must sense gate applicability via shared _plan_review_gate_applies helper and claim_gate_check; claim core executes only on PASS verdict; on BLOCK/INDETERMINATE/retryable-degrade the claim is not attempted and the command exits with the corresponding disposition code

Both flags must use lazy in-function imports of _disposition_exit_code, not hold the store lock across the review phase, and allow review_plan exceptions to propagate through the standard CLI error handler
claim --review must print a one-line skip notice and proceed without review when the plan-review gate does not apply (disabled or exempt type)
Help texts must document non-atomicity and reference review-plan --status; docs/cli-reference.md must be regenerated and docs/exit-codes.md updated to document the new exit codes
